item.text: L’inventario conferma che tutti gli IP richiesti e le rotte statiche esistono già. I cinque ruoli DNS restano distinti e `kathara/base` include BIND9, quindi non è necessario alterare alcuna immagine in `lab.conf`.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- lab.conf && for pair in 'root pc2/etc/bind/db.root' 'test. pc3/etc/bind/db.test' 'services.test. pc12/etc/bind/db.services.test'; do set -- "'$pair; if command -v named-checkzone >/dev/null 2>&1; then named-checkzone "$1" "$2"; else echo "named-checkzone unavailable: $1"; fi; done && if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in pc2 pc3 pc9 pc11 pc12; do named-checkconf -t "$PWD/$f" /etc/bind/named.conf; done; else echo '"'named-checkconf unavailable'; fi && rg -n 'forwarders|named\\.conf\\.default-zones|nameserver|systemctl restart named|type (master|slave|hint)|allow-transfer|recursion|dnssec-validation' pc{2,3,4,6,9,11,12}"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- lab.conf && for pair in 'root pc2/etc/bind/db.root' 'test. pc3/etc/bind/db.test' 'services.test. pc12/etc/bind/db.services.test'; do set -- "'$pair; if command -v named-checkzone >/dev/null 2>&1; then named-checkzone "$1" "$2"; else echo "named-checkzone unavailable: $1"; fi; done && if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in pc2 pc3 pc9 pc11 pc12; do named-checkconf -t "$PWD/$f" /etc/bind/named.conf; done; else echo '"'named-checkconf unavailable'; fi && rg -n 'forwarders|named\\.conf\\.default-zones|nameserver|systemctl restart named|type (master|slave|hint)|allow-transfer|recursion|dnssec-validation' pc{2,3,4,6,9,11,12}"

item.text:
Configurata la gerarchia DNS richiesta.

- Ruoli: `pc2` root, `pc3` master `test.`, `pc9` slave `test.`, `pc12` master `services.test.`, `pc11` resolver con soli root hints interni.
- Creati i file BIND in `pc2`, `pc3`, `pc9`, `pc11`, `pc12`; aggiunti riavvio `named` e resolver client a `pc4`/`pc6`.
- `lab.conf` invariato: `kathara/base` già include BIND9.
- Nessun forwarder, DNS pubblico, modifica a IP/rotte/topologia, o record applicativi in `/etc/hosts`.
- Verifica statica completata; `named-checkconf` e `named-checkzone` non sono installati nell’ambiente locale.
